prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Spotlight Showcase: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a spotlight layout to highlight pet personalities clearly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pet companion personality and appearance that fits your daily desktop routine."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Custom Trait Screen: Adds a dedicated preview screen right after choosing a friend to set initial pet traits before upload.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_preview": {"headline": "Customize Companion Traits", "body": "Fine-tune your pet's core energy and responsiveness before completing adoption.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Continue to Photos"}}
2: [home, new_flow] Real-Time Pet Generation Flow: Rebuilds the waiting screen into a dynamic step-by-step checklist showing live generation progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Building Your Custom Companion", "body": "Generating pet graphics, desktop physics, and behavior patterns..."}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Orientation Split View: Redesigns the final intro screen into a split view showing how the pet behaves on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "body": "Your pet will now appear directly on your desktop screen. Click or drag to interact."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Pet generation typically takes under 2 minutes. We will alert you as soon as your pet is ready."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safeguard Copy: Updates sign-in screen text to emphasize that signing in protects pet save states across devices and sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your adopted pets and progress are safely backed up to your account."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Adds photo preparation instructions on the upload screen to improve custom pet rendering quality.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and simple backgrounds."}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Path Choice Split View: Changes the path selection layout to a side-by-side split comparison of preset versus custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Adoption Experience", "body": "Select whether to adopt a pre-designed desktop pet or create a custom companion from your photos."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal: Adds an official adoption seal badge component onto the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Companion Adoption Seal", "style": "playful", "label": "Certified Pet"}]}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Quick Help Toast Hint: Triggers a helpful hint toast shortly after entering home intro explaining how to reveal desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"tip_delay_seconds": 3, "hint": "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open companion controls and options."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the friend selection layout while maintaining the screen's core job of choosing a pet.
Adds a valid preview step inside onboarding without removing required steps or violating design rules.
Rebuilds the waiting screen into a dynamic checklist while keeping its essential function of showing pet generation progress.
Redesigns the home intro screen into a split view within allowed onboarding boundaries.
Adds standard waiting screen notifications and realistic time estimates without deceptive timing.
Updates copy on the sign-in screen to clarify account persistence benefits.
Provides helpful preparation instructions on the photo upload screen.
Changes path selection layout while preserving options for both adoption and custom pet creation.
Adds an official adoption seal component to the adoption certificate screen.
Adds a non-intrusive quick help hint on the home intro screen.
